subject: Low Impact Development and Stormwater Runoff
overview: Speakers presented a public service announcement detailing how stormwater runoff carries road pollutants directly into local waterways. The presentation outlined low impact development techniques to promote ground absorption and reduce runoff.

items.title: Stormwater Runoff Impact
items.summary: Leilani Mroczkowsk described how heavy rain carries street and sidewalk oil directly through stormwater drains into local waterways.

items.title: Low Impact Development Techniques
items.summary: Matt Shuman explained how low impact development uses green spaces, tree preservation, and porous pavement to absorb rainwater into the ground rather than directing it to storm drains.
